metadata.title: CRR Coverage Heat Map — IACP Skirmish Async (Skirbo)
metadata.v1_7_update: 2026-04-17: B4 + B5 closure pass — the last two inferred_only rows reclassified → direct_oracle. D2 Difficult+Hostile Terrain Stacking: tests/domain/oracle/terrain-stacking-probes.test.js (PROBE-TERRAIN-001..008, 11 assertions) pins additive cost shape (base 1, +1 difficult, +1 hostile, stack = 3) using a 3-cell synthetic corridor fed through buildTempBoardState + computeMovementCache, plus separate ignoreDifficult / ignoreFigureCost suppression lanes and a source-pin on evaluateMovementStep cost lines. D4 Multi-Condition Interaction: tests/domain/oracle/multi-condition-probes.test.js (PROBE-COND-001..008, 17 assertions) pins co-existence of 3+ conditions, dedup-on-reapply, independent removal, per-figure isolation, empty-array cleanup (delete key), Disarm-permanent-Weaken cross-condition guard (the sole non-independent rule), resetCondition idempotency, and a source-pin on conditions.js mutators. No production bugs surfaced during the pass. Distribution after closure: direct_oracle 47 → 49, certification 3, inferred_only 2 → 0, uncovered 0. Full CRR heat-map now covered by direct_oracle or certification — no inferred_only or uncovered rows remain.
metadata.v1_6_1_repair: 2026-04-17: Artifact-repair pass. The narrative was rolled back to v1.6 but four closure-supporting test files remained on disk (tests/certification/map-topology-certification.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/sor-sequencing-probes.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/mission-scoring-probes3.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/free-attack-mutex-probes.test.js) and all 4 pass (105/105 when run together). Row classifications restored based on repo reality, not old narrative labels: D3 Free-attack window mutex inferred_only → direct_oracle (free-attack-mutex-probes.test.js — 13 assertions); D7 Start-of-Round DC Effects Sequencing inferred_only → direct_oracle (sor-sequencing-probes.test.js — 17 assertions, real [First Strike] ReferenceError bug fixed in round.js:1072/923/941 + setup-bridge.js:459 still in place); D8 Mission-specific scoring variants inferred_only → direct_oracle (mission-scoring-probes3.test.js — 15 assertions, includes VP-015b-i honest-measurement pair for the reverted getCrateDeploymentVpBonus selectedMap-object-vs-string comparison bug); D10 Map Topology and Adjacency inferred_only → certification (map-topology-certification.test.js — 60 test cases). VP-015b-i probe rewritten from CRR-correct-assertion to honest-measurement-pair (mirrors PROBE-LOADOUT-05 electro_pulse pattern) because the production-side mission-helpers.js fix was intentionally reverted; companion notDeepStrictEqual trips the moment the fix lands. Distribution after repair: direct_oracle 44 → 47, certification 2 → 3, inferred_only 6 → 2, totals unchanged. Remaining inferred_only: D2 Difficult+Hostile terrain stacking and D4 Multi-condition interaction — the true B4+B5 pair.
metadata.tier_a_update: 2026-04-14: Tier A probes added (surge-legality-probes.test.js, combat-token-timing-probes.test.js). Condition immunity reclassified from unit_test to direct_oracle (ORACLE-HANDLER-003 already covers it).
metadata.v1_2_expansion: 2026-04-16: Heat-map expanded 35 → 55 entries. Handler-vs-engine parity broken out into 13 per-scenario D3 entries (Reach family: permanent/nextAttackReach/Fury/Electrostaff; Hide non-filter; Priority Target/Marksman/Clawdite LOS bypass; Insignificant/Dio; I Must Go Alone; Fire Mission group-LOS; Vanish immunity; default-agreement positive control). Five honest uncovered entries added (LOS-06 Energy Shield, LOS Slice 2 door, LOS Slice 2 multi-cell figure, post-target-select combat gating, loadout-card passives beyond Reach). Two inferred_only additions (mission-specific scoring variants, free-attack window mutex). No new direct_oracle test files authored in this pass — measurement only.
metadata.v1_3_update: 2026-04-16: Post-Target-Select Combat Gating row reclassified uncovered → direct_oracle. tests/certification/post-select-gating.test.js v2 now pins all 12 flag-gated branches of combat.js:869–969 (4 block gates + 8 consumption windows + 1 positive control) via a narrow shadow. Side effects and combat resolution explicitly out of scope; engine-blindness (11-of-12) tracked as report-only number. Distribution: direct_oracle 39 → 40, uncovered 5 → 4.
metadata.v1_4_update: 2026-04-16: LOS Slice 2 lane — both LOS Slice 2 rows (Doors + Multi-cell figures) reclassified uncovered → direct_oracle. tests/domain/oracle/los-slice2-probes.test.js pins the CRR-required LOS behaviors via 4 probes (closed-door block, open-door no-block, multi-cell attacker any-cell LOS, multi-cell target any-cell reachability). Two new handler-parity scenarios (14 closed door, 15 multi-cell attacker top-left-only) surface the engine's drift; shadow expanded to merge closed-door edges into effectiveMs and iterate attacker-fp × target-fp. Parity scenario 14 engine_only=['Greedo-1-0'], scenario 15 handler_only=['Greedo-1-0']. Stale engine_location pointers from src/game/los.js (never existed) → src/game/spatial.js (actual file). LOS-06 Energy Shield still uncovered (intentionally out of scope). Distribution: direct_oracle 40 → 42, uncovered 4 → 2.
metadata.v1_5_update: 2026-04-16: LOS-06 Energy Shield lane — reclassified uncovered → direct_oracle. tests/domain/oracle/los-06-energy-shield-probes.test.js pins the three CRR p.28 carve-outs via 4 probes (LOS out of shield, LOS into shield, LOS not through shield, multi-cell attacker + shield self-exclusion). One new handler-parity scenario (16 — shield between attacker and target on open terrain) baselines the engine's shield-blindness: engine never consults game.ancillaryTokens.energyShield; handler merges shields into effectiveMs.blocking at dc-play-area.js:951-968. Shadow expanded to merge shield spaces into blocking. Parity scenario 16 engine_only=['Greedo-1-0']. Diagonal-corner shield rule (p.28/p.40 intersection) deferred as a separate follow-up mini-lane. Distribution: direct_oracle 42 → 43, uncovered 2 → 1.
metadata.v1_6_update: 2026-04-16: Loadout-card lane — reclassified uncovered → direct_oracle. tests/domain/oracle/loadout-card-probes.test.js adds 12 probes across three layers: (1) data integrity (exactly one loadout passive = Electrostaff/Reach; every card carries surgeKeys + postAttack); (2) handler injection shadow for all 3 cards (Electrostaff/Electrohammer/Electrobatons) plus a source-pin on combat.js:1203-1208 that catches refactors of the injection lines; (3) combat-bridge postAttack side-effect probes for quick_strike (defender-modified-dice → 1 damage, with negative control) and flurry_of_blows (free 1-green melee override queued, once-per-activation lock). DISCOVERED BUG: electro_pulse is a silent no-op in production — combat-bridge.js:1470 msgId lookup does `_epDcL[idx].dgIndex === _epDgIdx` but setup-bridge.js:480-491 never emits dgIndex on dcList entries, so the lookup always returns undefined. PROBE-LOADOUT-05 honestly measures the broken behavior (no adjacency damage applied) and source-pins the buggy line + dcList shape so any fix trips the pin and forces a probe rewrite. Fixing the bug is a separate gameplay lane, out of scope here. Last uncovered row closed. Distribution: direct_oracle 43 → 44, uncovered 1 → 0.
metadata.methodology: Four-domain audit of engine source against Consolidated Rules Reference. Coverage classified as: direct_oracle (pure-function oracle probe), runtime_invariant (RT-1..RT-12 checked in training loop), certification (card catalog regression), unit_test (co-located or tests/domain unit), headless_selfplay (end-to-end headless game), inferred_only (exercised by selfplay but never explicitly asserted), uncovered (no test or runtime check).

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Each activation grants exactly 2 actions; specials/moves/attacks each cost 1 unless modified
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-001..AS-010 (action-surfacing-probes*.test.js) pin remaining-action gates for move, attack, dc_special, cc_special, cc_double
coverage.notes: Core action budget is well-pinned. 10 probes across 3 batch files.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Move action offered when remaining >= 1 and not blocked by stun/massive-lock
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-005 (activationExtraActionThenStun blocks move), PROBE-AS-006 (massiveMovementLocked blocks move)
coverage.notes: Both movement-blocking gates tested with positive+negative pairs.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Attack offered once per activation unless Assault or free-attack flag set
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-007 (Assault), PROBE-FA-001..FA-003 (freeAttackBonusPending, imperialRetrofittingMultiAttack, fellSwoopFreeAttack), PROBE-FA-001b (paired negative)
coverage.notes: 5 of 5 bypass flags tested. Assault keyword tested via Baze Malbus.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Interact offered only to sentient non-companion figures at valid interact targets; blocked by Non-Sentient trait, companion status, Alter Mind
coverage.evidence: PROBE-INT-001..INT-005 (interact-legality-probes.test.js): Non-Sentient blocked, companion blocked, normal offered, Beast Tamer override, Alter Mind blocks interact
coverage.notes: All 4 interact gates tested. Terminal position h21 on mos-eisley-outskirts verified.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: DC special actions offered when remaining actions >= cost (all currently cost 1)
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-009 (remaining=1 offered, remaining=0 blocked for Bossk Indiscriminate Fire)
coverage.notes: No DC currently has specialCosts > 1; all default via ?? 1.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: CC special actions require remaining >= 1; CC Double (On the Lam) requires remaining >= 2
coverage.evidence: PROBE-AS-010 (CC special blocked at remaining=0), PROBE-AS-008 (CC Double at remaining=2 vs <2)
coverage.notes: Both gates pinned with paired positive/negative probes.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Movement uses BFS on adjacency graph; terrain modifiers apply per edge (difficult = +1, impassable = blocked)
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/movement-*.test.js (6 files, ~200 probes): pathfinding, terrain costs, large figures, blocking, doors
coverage.notes: Movement is the most heavily oracle-tested subsystem.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Large (2x2) figures occupy 4 cells; all 4 must be legal; rotation allowed during movement
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/movement-large-figure*.test.js: large figure pathfinding, blocking, rotation
coverage.notes: Multiple probe files dedicated to large figure edge cases.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Abilities like Deference Protocol, Parting Blow trigger on movement through specific spaces
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/movement-trigger*.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/movement-interrupt*.test.js
coverage.notes: Core triggers tested but not all DC-specific movement triggers have dedicated probes.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Difficult terrain costs +1 movement; hostile terrain is separate effect. Combined cost should be movement+1 with hostile damage.
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/terrain-stacking-probes.test.js — PROBE-TERRAIN-001..008 pin additive stacking (base 1, +1 difficult, +1 hostile, stack = 3) + ignoreDifficult/ignoreFigureCost suppression shape + source-pin on evaluateMovementStep cost lines
coverage.notes: Phase-2 B4 closure (2026-04-17). Pure-function probe uses buildTempBoardState + computeMovementCache on a 3-cell synthetic corridor; additive-sum assertion pins shape against future max/clamp/multiplicative drift.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Damage = attack_damage - defense_evades - defense_blocks, minimum 0. Pierce reduces blocks.
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-damage*.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/combat-pierce*.test.js, src/game/damage-helpers.test.js
coverage.notes: Core damage pipeline heavily tested with many edge cases.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Ranged attacks require accuracy >= distance; melee attacks always hit if adjacent
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-accuracy*.test.js: accuracy checks, range validation, miss-on-insufficient-accuracy
coverage.notes: Accuracy-range interaction well-tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: LOS requires unblocked corner-to-corner line between attacker and target cells; figures, walls, doors block
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/los-*.test.js (multiple files): wall blocking, figure blocking, door blocking, edge cases
coverage.notes: LOS-06 (energy shield exception) still OPEN P2. Figure-blocking LOS (Slice 1) closed. Slice 2 (doors/multi-cell/Hide/CC) deferred.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Each player may reroll once per attack (attacker then defender); reroll replaces original result
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-reroll*.test.js: reroll offered/consumed, result replacement
coverage.notes: Reroll flow well-tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Surges can only be spent on available surge abilities; each surge ability used at most once per attack
coverage.evidence: PROBE-SURGE-001..004 (surge-legality-probes.test.js): surge chart retrieval, blockSurgeAbilities gate, double-surge prefix + parsing, legal accumulation through handler pipeline (7 assertions)
coverage.notes: Tier A upgrade. Surge chart, cost detection (double: prefix), block flag, and pipeline damage verified.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Power tokens (focus, hidden) must be applied at correct combat phase; focus adds attack die, hidden subtracts accuracy; both consumed after resolution
coverage.evidence: PROBE-TOKEN-001..003 (combat-token-timing-probes.test.js): Hidden -2 accuracy causes ranged miss through handler pipeline + paired control, Focus consumed post-resolution, Hidden consumed from both sides (4 assertions)
coverage.notes: Tier A upgrade. Semantic timing pinned: Hidden penalty in combat result, condition consumption after resolution.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Blast N deals N damage to all figures adjacent to target; Cleave N deals N damage to all adjacent hostile figures
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/combat-blast*.test.js, tests/domain/oracle/combat-cleave*.test.js
coverage.notes: AoE abilities well-covered.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Melee attacks require adjacency; ranged attacks require LOS and accuracy >= distance. isRanged flag must match weapon profile.
coverage.evidence: CERT-ATK-001..004 (attack-type-certification.test.js): all non-attachment combatants have valid type, Reach melee accuracy exempted, no unexpected types, isRanged derivation consistent, ranged DCs have accuracy dice (4 assertions, full catalog sweep)
coverage.notes: Tier B upgrade. Sweep found 3 melee DCs with accuracy surges (K-2S0, Kanan, Zeb) — all confirmed Reach figures. 2 ranged DCs with configurable dice (Weiss, IG-88) — legitimate. No anomalies.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Some figures are immune to specific conditions; immunity should prevent condition application during combat resolution
coverage.evidence: ORACLE-HANDLER-003 (combat-handler-oracles.test.js): immune Snowtrooper Elite blocks Stun despite positive damage (003a), blocks multiple harmful (003b), non-immune receives conditions (003c). ORACLE-HANDLER-004: Fireproof blocks Bleed but not Stun. All through resolveCombatAfterRolls pipeline.
coverage.notes: Reclassified from unit_test to direct_oracle. ORACLE-HANDLER-003/004 were already handler-level integration probes — initial heat map assessment was wrong.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Conditions (stun, bleed, weaken, focus, hidden) apply/remove according to specific timing rules
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/condition-*.test.js, src/game/conditions.test.js: application, removal, stun consuming action, bleed damage
coverage.notes: Individual conditions well-tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Multiple conditions can co-exist; each resolves independently
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/multi-condition-probes.test.js — PROBE-COND-001..008 pin co-existence of 3+ conditions, dedup-on-reapply, independent removal, per-figure isolation, empty-array cleanup, Disarm-permanent-Weaken cross-condition guard, resetCondition idempotency, source-pin on conditions.js mutators
coverage.notes: Phase-2 B5 closure (2026-04-17). Disarm-Weaken is the single cross-condition rule in conditions.js; all other conditions resolve independently via per-figure string array. Probe pins both the independence shape and the Disarm guard.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: When a figure is defeated, opponent gains VP equal to deployment cost; figure removed from board
coverage.evidence: tests/domain/oracle/defeat-*.test.js: VP award, figure removal, companion defeat, last-figure-standing
coverage.notes: Defeat and VP award well-pinned.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: When all figures in a deployment group are defeated, the group's activation is removed from the round; partial defeat does not remove activation
coverage.evidence: PROBE-GD-001..003 (group-defeat-activation-probes.test.js): full 3-figure group wipe → activation removed, partial 1-of-3 defeat → activation persists, progressive defeat through all 3 → removed only on last (3 probes, 7 assertions)
coverage.notes: Tier B upgrade. Stormtrooper (Elite) 3-figure group used. All three defeat patterns tested through real processFigureDefeat pipeline.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Figures deploy into friendly deployment zone; reinforcements deploy at start of round into valid spaces
coverage.evidence: Headless selfplay deploys armies each game. Deployment zone coords used in mission-scoring-probes2.test.js. No dedicated deployment legality oracle.
coverage.notes: Initial deployment exercised every game but zone legality never explicitly asserted.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Round: Status Phase → Activation Phase (alternating activations) → End of Round. Initiative swaps each round.
coverage.evidence: src/game/phase.test.js, src/game/activation-state.test.js: phase transitions, initiative swap, activation ordering
coverage.notes: Core round loop well-tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Per-round flags (attackPerformed, movement locks, etc.) reset at round boundary
coverage.evidence: RT-1..RT-4 check state consistency in training loop. activation-state.test.js tests flag reset. ROUND_OBJECT_FLAGS/ROUND_NULL_FLAGS enumerate all flags.
coverage.notes: Flag reset is both oracle-tested and runtime-checked.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Some DCs have start-of-round effects that must resolve before activation phase begins; Block A (DC passives) resolves initiative-first per IA rules; Block B (Skirmish Upgrades) fires once per game for round-1 effects via global/per-player flags
coverage.engine_location: src/handlers/round.js:1071 runStartOfRoundDcEffects (Block A DC passives 1078-1158, Block B Skirmish Upgrades 1160-1262); src/handlers/round.js:1272 resolveStartOfRoundEffect (counter decrement + pre_activation gate)
coverage.evidence: PROBE-SOR-001..006 (tests/domain/oracle/sor-sequencing-probes.test.js — 17 assertions across 6 probe groups): return-value semantics, First Strike round-1 guard + owner-agnostic + once-per-game flag, Ezra Brush every-round sync + defeated-skip, Block A initiative-first ordering via Ezra×2 log-order probe, resolveStartOfRoundEffect counter decrement + pre_activation phase-gate open + pendingSorActions clear, source pin on _sorPlayerOrder / Block B [1,2] / round-1 guards / return expression / pre_activation gate call.
coverage.notes: Real bug surfaced + fixed during probe authoring: runStartOfRoundDcEffects called checkWinConditions at round.js:1179 but only destructured logGameAction + updateHandChannelMessages from ctx — ReferenceError on round 1 whenever either player owned [First Strike]. Fix added checkWinConditions to the destructure + propagated through both call sites (round.js:923 _continueAfterMissionSor and setup-bridge.js:459 fallback). Block B uses hardcoded [1,2] order rather than initiative-first — functionally fine for current effects (all self-contained VP or CC hand ops), latent invariant-drift risk for future order-sensitive upgrades; flagged as INFERRED risk, not patched. Picker paths (Rule by Fear, Rogue One, Imperial Citadel, Programming Override, Clawdite Shape/Shift) covered only by counter-increment contract + source pin — full picker→resolve→next-effect end-to-end is a separate mini-lane.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: End-of-round VP awarded for controlling specific map spaces (objective tokens, terminals)
coverage.evidence: PROBE-VP-001..VP-005 (mission-scoring-probes.test.js): vpPerLaunchPanelControlled, vpPerControlledSpaceInList, vpPerTokenForControllingCell, autoDistributeCrateTokens
coverage.notes: Core objective scoring well-pinned across 5 handler variants.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: VP awarded for strict majority in a deployment zone (more figures than opponent)
coverage.evidence: PROBE-VP-010 (mission-scoring-probes2.test.js): 2 vs 1 → VP; 1 vs 1 tie → 0
coverage.notes: Strict majority (not >=) tested.

coverage.subdomain: VP Per Contraband in Opponent Zone

coverage.evidence: PROBE-VP-011 (mission-scoring-probes2.test.js): in zone → VP+consumed; not in zone → retained
coverage.notes: Initiative-aware zone lookup tested.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Alter Mind (Obi-Wan): opponent's cost<=9 figures within 3 spaces don't count for space control
coverage.evidence: PROBE-ABILITY-001 (control-exclusion-probes.test.js): no Alter Mind → P2 controls; Obi-Wan within 3 → P2 excluded → null
coverage.notes: BFS distance d1↔a1 = 3 spaces verified.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Powerful Influence: opponent figures within 3 spaces of friendly Rebel Force User don't count for control
coverage.evidence: PROBE-ABILITY-002 (control-exclusion-probes.test.js): no PI → null (shared); PI active → P2 excluded → P1 controls
coverage.notes: Luke Skywalker used as Rebel Force User. b1↔a1 = 1 space.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: All DC/CC cards have valid data: correct costs, abilities, figure counts, surge charts, etc.
coverage.evidence: tests/certification/: catalog certification covering all 410+ cards. tests/headless/destruct-dc-tests.js, destruct-cc-tests.js
coverage.notes: Full catalog certified. Any new card addition would be caught.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Command cards have specific timing windows (start of activation, during attack, etc.) and playability conditions
coverage.evidence: src/game/cc-timing.test.js: timing window validation. PROBE-CC-001..CC-003 in oracle tests.
coverage.notes: Timing windows tested but not all CC cards have dedicated playability probes.

coverage.crr_rule_or_claim: Map adjacency graph is correct; spaces, walls, doors, terrain types match physical map layout; adjacency is symmetric and king-move-constrained
coverage.evidence: tests/certification/map-topology-certification.test.js — 60 test cases across 8 invariants × 8 playable maps + 3 handcrafted BFS anchors on mos-eisley-outskirts (d1↔a1=3, e21↔h21=3, b1↔a1=1). Invariants: adjacency keys ⊆ spaces, no phantom neighbors, no self-loops, no duplicate neighbors, symmetric adjacency, king-move constraint (Chebyshev ≤ 1), impassable/movement-blocking edges are king-move pairs touching spaces.
coverage.notes: No topology defects found across all 8 playable maps.

top_5_risks.description: No test validates that surges can only be spent on available surge abilities or that each ability is used at most once per attack. If the engine allows illegal surge spending, damage is inflated.

top_5_risks.risk: Power Token Application Timing in Combat
top_5_risks.description: Focus and Hidden tokens are tested in isolation but not in the combat flow. If tokens are applied at the wrong phase (before vs after roll), dice pool effects are wrong.
isConditionImmune tested in isolation but never exercised through a combat resolution that attempts to apply a condition to an immune figure.
top_5_risks.recommended_action: RECLASSIFIED — ORACLE-HANDLER-003 already covered this at handler level

top_5_risks.description: No test validates that the isRanged flag in DC data matches the card's actual weapon type. A wrong flag would let melee figures attack at range or ranged figures only attack adjacent.
When all figures in a multi-figure deployment group are defeated, the group's activation should be removed from the round. No test verifies this for groups of 2+ figures.
